panels.title: Targets Up %
panels.description: Central Prometheus's own scrape targets reporting up (node, PVE, Ceph, PBS, blackbox, OTel endpoint, self). Excludes k8s metrics re-exported through the OTel collector (exported_job=*) whose count churns with pod lifecycle — see the Kubernetes dashboard for those. Not the Fleet/osquery server.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100*countIf(v=1)/greatest(count(),1) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='up' AND Attributes['exported_job']='' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ServiceName)

SELECT 100*avg(v) AS value FROM (SELECT avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='probe_success' AND ServiceName='blackbox-http-apps' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

SELECT coalesce(sum(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_node_status_condition' AND Attributes['condition']='Ready' AND Attributes['status']='true' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_status_phase' AND Attributes['phase'] IN ('Failed','Unknown','Pending') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1 UNION ALL SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['pod'] AS pod FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason' AND Attributes['reason']='CrashLoopBackOff' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=1)

panels.title: CNPG Backup Age
panels.description: Worst-case age of CNPG Postgres backups (Barman plugin). Restic/Talos & PBS tracked separately.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (toUnixTimestamp(now())-min(v))/3600 AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

panels.title: Site Power
panels.description: Live rack power draw, measured at the UPS (CP1500PFCRM2U, 1000W rated).

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(v)*10 AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='network_ups_tools_ups_load' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])
SELECT count() AS value FROM suricata.alert WHERE Timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND alert_severity IN (1,2) AND alert_signature_id NOT IN (0)

SELECT coalesce(max(v),0) AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

SELECT instance, probe_hostname, probe_namespace, v AS value FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['probe_hostname'] AS probe_hostname, Attributes['probe_namespace'] AS probe_namespace, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='probe_success' AND ServiceName='blackbox-http-apps' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) WHERE v=0 ORDER BY probe_hostname

SELECT s.instance AS instance, s.device AS device, s.v AS value, t.v AS threshold FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_available_spare' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device, Attributes, ServiceName, StartTimeUnix) s INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['device'] AS device, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='smartctl_device_available_spare_threshold' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, device, Attributes, ServiceName, StartTimeUnix) t ON s.instance=t.instance AND s.device=t.device WHERE s.v <= t.v

panels.title: App availability — instant vs rolling 24h
panels.description: Minute-by-minute fleet probe success shows active outages; rolling 24h matches the App Avail 24h stat and shows historical drag.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'instant availability' AS series, 100*avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='probe_success' AND ServiceName='blackbox-http-apps' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time, 'rolling 24h' AS series, 100*avg(v) AS value FROM (SELECT time, ServiceName, instance, Attributes, argMax(rolling, TimeUnix) AS v FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, TimeUnix, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes, avg(Value) OVER (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY toUnixTimestamp(TimeUnix) RANGE BETWEEN 86400 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='probe_success' AND ServiceName='blackbox-http-apps' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND $__toTime) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, ServiceName, instance, Attributes) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT instance, 100*(1-avg(idle)) AS value FROM (SELECT instance, ServiceName, Attributes, sum(delta)/300 AS idle FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, ServiceName, Attributes, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_cpu_seconds_total' AND Attributes['mode']='idle' AND Attributes['instance_type']='proxmox_host' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 900 SECOND AND now() WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 300 SECOND GROUP BY instance, ServiceName, Attributes) GROUP BY instance ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT instance, 100*(1-a.v/nullIf(t.v,0)) AS value FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes' AND Attributes['instance_type']='proxmox_host' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, Attributes, ServiceName) a INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_memory_MemTotal_bytes' AND Attributes['instance_type']='proxmox_host' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, Attributes, ServiceName) t ON a.instance=t.instance ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT time, reason, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, Attributes['reason'] AS reason, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='hubble_drop_total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, reason ORDER BY time

panels.title: CNPG Postgres — hours since last backup
panels.description: Plugin backup age per cluster (worst first).

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['cluster'] AS cluster, (toUnixTimestamp(now())-v)/3600 AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='barman_cloud_cloudnative_pg_io_last_available_backup_timestamp' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Restic / Talos snapshots — hours since last success

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['plan_id'] AS plan_id, Attributes['path'] AS path, (toUnixTimestamp(now())-v)/3600 AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='aether_restic_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id']) ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Power draw (W) — measured
panels.description: Red line = whole-rack wall draw (UPS). Stacked areas = measured CPU package power (RAPL) per Proxmox host + GPU power (DCGM). Excludes ARM SBCs, drives, and PSU losses, so stacked total < UPS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, concat(instance, ' CPU') AS series, sum(delta)/any(step) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, greatest($__interval_s, 60) AS step, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d)) AS delta FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='node_rapl_package_joules_total' AND ServiceName='proxmox-hosts-node' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY MetricName, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, instance ORDER BY time

SELECT time, concat(host, ' GPU') AS series, sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['Hostname'] AS host, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time, host, ServiceName, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], Attributes) GROUP BY time, host ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s, 60) SECOND) AS time, 'UPS total (wall)' AS series, max(Value)*10 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='network_ups_tools_ups_load' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT concat(instance, ' ', mountpoint) AS series, 100*(1-a.v/nullIf(t.v,0)) AS value FROM (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_filesystem_avail_bytes' AND Attributes['fstype'] NOT IN ('tmpfs','overlay','squashfs','ramfs') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, mountpoint, Attributes, ServiceName) a INNER JOIN (SELECT ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] AS instance, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='node_filesystem_size_bytes' AND Attributes['fstype'] NOT IN ('tmpfs','overlay','squashfs','ramfs') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY instance, mountpoint, Attributes, ServiceName) t ON a.instance=t.instance AND a.mountpoint=t.mountpoint ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT Attributes['Hostname'] AS Hostname, Attributes['gpu'] AS gpu, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Hostname, gpu

options.content:
### Drill-down

**Security:** [Security Triage](/d/security-triage) · [IDS Monitoring](/d/ids-monitoring) · [Fleet](https://fleet.home.shdr.ch)

**Platform:** [Kubernetes](/d/kubernetes-main) · [Ceph](/d/ceph-monitoring-main) · [Proxmox](/d/Dp7Cd57Zza) · [Hosts](/d/rYdddlPWk) · [Disk Health](/d/ce8j0dmrrej9cc) · [PBS](/d/f0814b49-4e9a-4efa-89c0-061221f25af5) · [Certificates](/d/certificates/certificates)

**Edge/apps:** [Reverse Proxy](/d/fed94ifiv8h6oc) · [DNS](/d/network) · [HAProxy](/d/rEqu1u5ue) · [UPS](/d/j4a-DMWRk)

**Alerting:** [all rules](/alerting/list) · `channel`/`domain`/`criticality` → Apprise (ntfy+Matrix); `DeadMansSwitch` firing = BY DESIGN (Kuma heartbeat). Ceph OSD-down = dead NVMe on neo (hardware).

targets.rawSql: SELECT (toUnixTimestamp(now())-min(v))/3600 AS value FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='aether_restic_snapshot_last_success_timestamp_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

panels.title: Certificate Issues
panels.description: Expired local certificates, failed renewal units, or Kubernetes certificates near expiry and not Ready. Zero is healthy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT countIf(v=1) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='x509_cert_expired' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])) + (SELECT countIf(v=1) FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='systemd_unit_state' AND Attributes['state']='failed' AND match(Attributes['name'], '(backrest-cert-renew|openbao-cert-renew|step-ca-cert-renew)\\.(service|timer)') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])) + (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['name'] AS name FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='certmanager_certificate_expiration_timestamp_seconds' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)-toUnixTimestamp(now()) < 3600 INTERSECT SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['name'] AS name FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='certmanager_certificate_ready_status' AND Attributes['condition']='True' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix)=0)) AS value

panels.title: 24h Energy (kWh)
panels.description: Rack energy over the last 24h, from UPS average load.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(v)*0.24 AS value FROM (SELECT avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='network_ups_tools_ups_load' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])

SELECT 100*su/(su+sf) AS value FROM (SELECT coalesce(sum(v),0) AS su FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])) AS used, (SELECT coalesce(sum(v),0) AS sf FROM (SELECT argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY Attributes, ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'])) AS free
